name: AnnaPearl's Strawberry Patch
description: In Pace, FL, AnnaPearl's Strawberry Patch raises Strawberries on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
